scope: Offline finalizer only; all training already complete. Recompute a raw-baseline metrics report in each verified arm context, then invoke unchanged development gate. No frozen source, predictions, stored metrics, threshold or failure status changes.
prior_review_miss: The original independent code review did not catch study-hash versus arm-hash mismatch in development_gate; new integration test reproduces this missed failure. This review does not rewrite the earlier pass evidence.
checks: Independently recomputed all six 384-row development metrics from saved predictions and verified equality with stored metrics.

Both arm completion records report 1530 steps and 12235 sample positions.
Raw baseline is re-evaluated only after exact arm contract validation; same input labels/predictions and unmodified gate. No relabeling or in-place hash edit.

Output is confined to separate recovery artifacts; original failed status and frozen trainer remain preserved.
Jev comparison consumes pinned development cache with hash/request validation; no network request path is called.
Original eight-file code review still validates unchanged.

coverage: Verified arm-context recomputation without changing prediction objects

findings.description: New tests use local ignored experimental artifacts. Missing artifacts now produce explicit SkipTest rather than failing a fresh clone.
Report describes unique record IDs rather than statistically independent records/scenarios.

limitations: This is approval of offline recovery bookkeeping, not approval of the candidate models. All six candidates fail the unchanged acceptance gate.
Development has been repeatedly observed and contains correlated synthetic macro stories; it does not establish blind real-user generalization.
Historical/staged latency is descriptive, not an equal-hardware-state causal speed comparison.
Frozen dependency/cache integrity validation may hash held-out artifacts, but this finalizer performs no held-out inference, scoring, label-guided training or selection.
Reviewer did not run finish or overwrite prior outputs; root performs the approved offline publication step.
